name: nagi turugi-madoi no gakuen nanahusigi-
original_name: ナギツルギ-幽惑の学園七不思議-
source:
Katagiri Mashiro is a male student who has a complex about being very easily scared.

By chance, he ends up sneaking into school at night, where he encounters a terrifying "monster".

When he is attacked by the monster and in dire straits, he is saved in the nick of time by a female exorcist, Nagi, his classmate.

After being scolded by Nagi for sneaking into school at night, Mashiro returns home in dismay...
But for some reason, Nagi asks him to help with his work as an exorcist...?

--Mashiro is asked to support the exorcism, and his role is to share his spiritual energy with Nagi by accepting the "fear" and "lust" stirred up by the monsters.

But of course, if he gives up, the monsters' merciless and erotic defeat and milking of his semen awaits! !

Transform your heart into power and defeat the monsters at school with Nagi!

[Translated from DLsite.]
